notes.title: SC2VN Prequel - Don't Forget Our Esports Dream
notes.notes:
We've gotten a lot of questions about if we would make more games like SC2VN, and today we launched Don't Forget Our Esports Dream. The game is a prequel set during the Brood War era, which focuses on Bolt from SC2VN and his relationship with Jett in her previous StarCraft career. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/946560/Dont_Forget_Our_Esports_Dream/

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10219478/da371671e02b6a1ce8566521716410af2fbd434a.jpg[/img]

We've added additional gameplay elements such as the Star Sense dialog system, which combines the Codex (glossary) with dialog choices. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10219478/3e11a8f654a9937161fa1b3cd642c995630c400a.jpg[/img]

There is also a unique system that lets you play mini micro-challenges over StarCraft scenes, which can earn you Steam achievements for having high APM. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10219478/ca285859226ee102355ae42c4e9c23ff8d30527d.jpg[/img]

Finally, fans of SC2VN will see the return of what made the original game stand out - memorable characters and a compelling story set in the competitive esports landscape. Thanks for all the support and kind reviews, and we hope to keep showing good games. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10219478/211f416e42278508e06349ba110237fad81639ab.png[/img]

notes.title: Continued support for SC2VN
notes.notes:
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/vogue/dont-forget-our-esports-dream-a-starcraft-visual-n][img]http://41.media.tumblr.com/b54cab348fb270726b4231f55040e9a6/tumblr_o5g2zmnRIf1sjrua6o1_1280.png[/img][/url]

Hey all! We’re happy to announce that a follow-up to SC2VN is in the works. Don’t Forget Our eSports Dream, a prequel to SC2VN, is currently on Kickstarter. Part of our ongoing support for SC2VN and its sequel raises the possibility of providing translations and voice acting. If you enjoyed our first game, please consider pledging. Learn more about [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/vogue/dont-forget-our-esports-dream-a-starcraft-visual-n]Don’t Forget Our eSports Dream here.[/url]

In addition to this announcement, we’ve fixed a few bugs and corrected a few typos in this update.
